hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has two languages Northern Nuristani languages Kati [bsh] and Kamviri [xvi]. It has long been known that these are mutually intelligible and locally understood to be so (**hh:st:Grjunberg:Kati**:16-23,
**hh:h:Strand:Nuristani**:298-299) although there is no indigenous name to encompass the entirety. The entries should be merged into one. See also: UNKNOWN [xvi].
